description: Real campus, real labs, and the work photographed in place. No stock, ever.
story: A standing rule from day one: no stock photography, anywhere in the system. These frames are the payoff — real students at real machines, and the standees photographed where they actually stand. When the brand shows a lab, it is that lab.

captions.campus-frame-iv.webp: The morning run in — a full bus of trainees.
captions.automation-lab-training.webp: The automation lab — Siemens rigs, real training.
